question: Why can parents not sort Homework (Permission missing) in UntisX (endpoint /messages)?
answer: Check role parents. Module Homework may require higher permissions. Error Permission missing: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /messages and the database connection. Feature Homework must be enabled.
